description: Rule of 40 score (revenue growth % + profit margin %), plus the magic number, burn multiple and SaaS quick ratio when their inputs are given. Full calculator: https://saascity.io/free-tools/rule-of-40-calculator

margin_pct.description: Profit margin in percent (EBITDA or free cash flow); negative when losing money

net_burn.description: Optional: net burn over a period, for the burn multiple

net_new_arr.description: Optional: net new ARR over the same period

new_mrr.description: Optional: new MRR, for the quick ratio

revenue_this_quarter.description: Optional: revenue this quarter, for the magic number

sales_marketing_last_quarter.description: Optional: sales and marketing spend last quarter

name: rule_of_40

result.description: The calculator result; percentages as 0-1 shares unless the key says pct

title: Rule of 40 and SaaS efficiency
